stem: Which statement best describes the role of parents in the healing of gingival soft tissue injuries after trauma to primary teeth?

options.text: Parental homecare has no bearing on healing outcomes.
Parental engagement in homecare is critical and influences healing of both the teeth and the soft tissues.
Parental homecare influences only the soft tissues and has no effect on the teeth.
Parental engagement is important only for injuries involving permanent teeth.
